description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveModel class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It models the data structure for employee leave information, including serialization details and properties like leave status, type, duration, start and end times.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee leave data, including properties like leave status, type, duration, start/end times, and related entities. Implements the Normalizable interface to support serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a Leave entity and sets up serialization filters and attribute mappings.
